raw_text: Thread on Bangladesh situation from Dhaka. The student protests have transformed into something much larger. What started as anti-quota agitation has become a referendum on the Hasina government. The coordination is remarkable — Telegram groups are running real-time logistics for medical aid, legal support, and protest routes. Facebook keeps getting throttled so students shifted entirely to Telegram and Signal. The government's internet shutdowns are making independent reporting nearly impossible. This is the biggest challenge to Hasina's authority since 2018.
